newsitem.title: JORDAN: King Hussein to visit Bahrain, Qatar.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein to visit Bahrain, Qatar.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan will fly to the Gulf on Tuesday for a two-day trip to Bahrain and Qatar, a palace official said on Monday.
The official said the king would spend Tuesday night in Bahrain before flying to neighbouring Qatar on Wednesday. He would return to Jordan on Thursday, the official said.

Jordanian ties with the oil-rich Gulf states, damaged by Jordan's perceived support for Iraqi President Saddam Hussein during his 1990-91 occupation of Kuwait, improved markedly when King Hussein turned against Baghdad last year.
Jordan, which stayed out of the U.S.-led coalition which recaptured Kuwait in 1991, has since called openly for a change of rule in Iraq.

When the United States rushed troops to Kuwait this month in a show of force towards the Iraqi leader, Jordan's Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti was quoted as saying Kuwait was entitled to take any measures it deemed necessary to defend itself.
